Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 8 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: leather three-seat sofa, 218 cm wide, 104 cm deep, 89 cm high
image 3: industrial rectangular coffee table, 135 cm wide, 75 cm deep, 40 cm high
image 4: wide open etagere bookcase, 140 cm wide, 21 cm deep, 43 cm high
image 5: black swing-arm floor reading lamp, size unknown
image 6: vintage-look fringed area rug, 290 cm wide, 229 cm deep
image 7: woven textured throw cushion, 43 cm wide, 43 cm deep, 15 cm high, 2 units
image 8: dark grey plant pot with saucer, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Es un loft con vigas de madera a la vista. Quiero un living de estilo industrial: un sofá de cuero marrón envejecido, una mesa ratona de madera maciza con patas de metal negro, una biblioteca de metal negro y madera contra la pared de la derecha, una lámpara de pie de metal y una alfombra grande en tonos tierra. Nada de blanco brillante: metal oscuro, cuero y madera.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
